question: Gymnastics Federation of India was established in _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **Gymnastics Federation of India** was established in the year **1951**. 
• The federation operates as the **national governing body** for gymnastics in India and is responsible for the development and promotion of the sport across the country. 
• It organizes various national-level gymnastics championships, training programs, and workshops to enhance the skills of gymnasts and coaches. 
• India has been actively participating in international gymnastics events under the aegis of the **Gymnastics Federation of India**, which works in collaboration with the **International Gymnastics Federation (FIG).** 
• Over the years, the federation has contributed to the growth of gymnastics as a competitive sport and has helped Indian gymnasts gain recognition on the global stage. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **International Gymnastics Federation (FIG):** 
• The **International Gymnastics Federation**, established in **1881**, is the **world governing body** for gymnastics. 
• It oversees various forms of gymnastics, including **Artistic Gymnastics, Rhythmic Gymnastics, Trampoline, Aerobic Gymnastics, and Acrobatic Gymnastics**. 
• FIG organizes international gymnastics competitions, including the **Olympic Games**, World Championships, and World Cups. 
• **Key Gymnastics Events:** 
• Major international events include the **Olympic Games, World Artistic Gymnastics Championships, and Asian Gymnastics Championships**. 
• India has been participating in these events, showcasing the talent of Indian gymnasts on the global stage. 
• **Role of Gymnastics Federation of India:** 
• The **Gymnastics Federation of India** is responsible for selecting gymnasts to represent India in international competitions. 
• It manages the training and development of gymnasts, providing them with access to facilities, coaches, and resources. 
• It also works on strategies to promote gymnastics at the grassroots level in India. 
• **Notable Indian Gymnasts:** 
• **Dipa Karmakar:** First Indian female gymnast to qualify for the **Olympics** (2016 Rio Games). 
• Her performance in the **Produnova Vault** brought international attention to Indian gymnastics. 
• Other gymnasts include **Rakesh Patra** and **Aruna Reddy**, who have performed in international championships. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Gymnastics in India:** 
• Gymnastics is still in its developmental stage in India, compared to other sports. 
• The Gymnastics Federation of India plays a crucial role in promoting the sport and ensuring India’s participation in international gymnastics events. 
• **Challenges in Gymnastics Development:** 
• Lack of adequate facilities and funding for gymnasts. 
• The need for experienced coaches and international exposure to improve the performance of Indian gymnasts.
